name: hud_stack_late_window_press_online
description: Online a READY lands later than offline: the turns the game holds and has not run yet (TurnSource.order_lead), its trip there and back (Game.order_trip, the measured round trip in whole turns: 6 ticks at one turn of latency) and a turn more (M8, design 5.7). Over loopback_main, in High Water with a partner, one press of N with 8 ticks of the window left, more than a turn, asks for a second press and sends nothing: the window's horn sounds on its own, my bead and the horn stay unlit, the strip counts no call ('· Ready 1/2' would be one), and wave 1 walks alone.

steps.msg: more than a turn left, but less than the order's lead, its trip and a turn

steps.assert: scene.controller.call_armed() and node('Notice').text == 'Call wave 2 now? Press again' and scene.settled()
steps.msg: the press asks for a second and sends nothing

steps.assert: Game.wave == 1 and Game.waves_on_road() == PackedInt32Array([1]) and not Game.is_ready() and not scene.controller.wants_ready()
steps.msg: the window's horn sounded on its own, nothing called

steps.assert: not node('Countdown').text.contains('Ready') and not node('PartyStrip').lines()[0].ends_with('ready') and not node('Ready').get_node('Ring').visible
steps.msg: my bead and the horn unlit, the strip counts no call
